changes.comment: BREAKING: Feishu-specific Team binding aliases are removed without compatibility forwarding (issue #209): `team.create.bind_group`, `team.bind_group`, and `team.transfer_channel_back` are gone. Channel binding is now the core Team MCP capability `bind_channel({ team_name, channel_id, meta })` / `transfer_back({ channel_id, meta })`; `channel_id` selects a configured channel, and `meta` is the provider-specific selector resolved by the channel provider (Feishu: `{ chat_id }`). There is no generic Channel MCP server or `channel-mcp` CLI surface. Feishu-specific actions such as `reply`, `react`, and `list_chat_bots` remain on the Feishu MCP server. Rebuild: no persisted state changes; any saved automation or instructions that call the removed Team binding aliases must switch to Team MCP `bind_channel` / `transfer_back`.
